units.source_text: “我就像那种和其他流派的人比武似的仔细观察着K，

en.t: I watched K closely, as though I were crossing swords with someone from another school,

units.source_text: 将我的眼睛、我的心脏、我的身体等，所有属于我的部位都包裹得没有一丝缝隙地提防着他。

en.t: keeping my eyes, my heart, my body, and every part of me sealed without the slightest opening as I guarded against him.

units.source_text: 单纯的K对人丝毫不加防备，不只是疏于防范，说他是在开门揖盗更恰如其分。

en.t: The innocent K had no defenses at all against others; more than merely careless, it would be more accurate to say he left the door wide open for a thief.

units.source_text: 这就好比，他把自己负责保管的要塞地图拱手相送，

en.t: It was as if he handed over the map of the fortress entrusted to his care,

units.source_text: 使我得以在他面前从容不迫地观看一般。

en.t: allowing me to look it over at leisure right before his eyes.

units.source_text: 我发现K正在理想与现实之间犹豫彷徨，

en.t: I saw that K was wavering and wandering between ideal and reality,

units.source_text: 于是我着眼于只消一击便能将他打倒的要害之处，并急速乘虚而入。

en.t: so I fixed my eyes on the vital point where one blow would bring him down, and quickly took advantage of his opening.

units.source_text: 我突然对他摆出了一副严肃庄重的表情，

en.t: I suddenly assumed a grave and formal expression toward him,

units.source_text: 这当然是一种策略，不过此时的紧张心情也恰巧与此神态相吻合，

en.t: which was of course a strategy, though my tension at the time happened to match that manner exactly,

units.source_text: 所以竟没有注意到自己的滑稽与可耻。

en.t: so I did not even notice how ridiculous and shameful I was.

units.source_text: 我首先声称‘在精神上没有上进心的人，是蠢货’。

en.t: I first declared, 'Anyone without spiritual ambition is a fool.'

units.source_text: 这是我们俩在房州旅行时，K对我说过的话。

en.t: These were words K had said to me when the two of us were traveling in Boshu.

units.source_text: 现在我又将K对我说过的这句话，模仿他当时的口气回敬给了他。

en.t: Now I hurled those same words that K had said to me back at him, imitating his tone from that time.

units.source_text: 但这绝不是出于报复心理，

en.t: But this was by no means out of a desire for revenge,

units.source_text: 坦白地说，我这样做的用意比报复更为残酷，

en.t: to be honest, my intention in doing this was even more cruel than revenge,

units.source_text: 因为，我要用这句话堵住K面前的爱情之路。

en.t: because I meant to use those words to block the path of love before K.
